correctness.rationale: The 12-vertex icosahedron has 30 specified edges. For r=3,4,5,6 the induced-component <=r condition defines finite simplicial complexes. Independently rebuilt every one of 4096 masks and every admissible face, then the four explicit pivot matchings, and for EVERY Hasse incidence constructed oriented edges and topologically sorted the directed matching graph. Reproduced counts: r=3 faces 713, pairs 351, one 0-cell+10 critical 3-cells, 2592 covers; r=4 faces 1133,pairs 531,0-cell+70 3-cells,4512 covers; r=5 faces1697,pairs673,0-cell+350 4-cells,7404 covers; r=6 faces2521,pairs1035,0-cell+450 5-cells,12360 covers. Acyclic discrete Morse CW models have no nonzero attaching targets except the unique point, so integral homotopy wedges follow, not just mod-two Betti numbers. Independent exhaustive deletion of every <=4 vertices leaves connected induced complements; hence for r=7..11 exact (r-1)-simplex skeleton with binom(11,r) spheres and r>=12 is contractible. This is exhaustive for finite 12-vertex object.

originality.rationale: Deshpande–Singh define Ind_r and classify broad but separate graph families including complete multipartite, whiskered, cycles and trees; Abdelmalek et al. treat chordal/tree/caterpillar shells. The icosahedral graph is 5-regular with triangles and nonchordal, so none of those family theorems specializes to the four intermediate homotopy types. Separate published icosahedral Čech/neighborhood complexes use graph-distance simplices and different face conditions. The high-r skeleton is a standard 5-connectivity consequence and not new by itself; the genuinely nontrivial new content is r=3..6 verified integral wedge classification.
residual_risks: Equivalent explicit icosahedral higher-independence homotopy calculations could exist in unindexed topology tables or graph-theory theses.

value.rationale: The canonical component-size higher-independence filtration on a standard Platonic graph has precisely four nontrivial intermediate stages between known small-r behavior and the high-r skeleton. Their integral homotopy types show large changes in sphere dimensions/multiplicities, and the explicit acyclic matchings are reusable finite certificates, not arbitrary numerical Betti ranks.

limitations: Nonequivariant homotopy of only the icosahedral 12-vertex graph; no maps between filtration stages or other graphs.
